title: Book Two · Chapter 90: The Notice People Read
story:
On Friday, children from another reading group visit the book wall. Miss Wu asks the groups to stay near their notices and answer simple questions. There is no prize for the most visitors.

Ronan stands beside Jun and their garden book. He checks the first line one last time. The child's name is clear now. The leaning gate is below the title.

Two younger children stop at Mei's fruit picture. They point and ask a question. They laugh at her answer. Ronan watches them for a little too long.

Jun taps the garden book. A child is in front of them.

“What happens at the gate?” she asks.

Ronan opens his mouth. Then he looks at the book. Their notice says the child waits there. But the visitor wants to know more.

“He waits for his sister,” Ronan says. “She has the basket.”

“What is inside?”

“Seeds.”

Jun opens the book to the picture. Ronan points to the basket. The girl looks closely and asks if she can read the first page. They give her room at the side of the table.

Another child comes. He wants the book after her. “Ask the helper at the borrowing corner,” Ronan says. “You can go there after this activity.” He does not promise the book himself.

Across the room, Leo has several visitors. He talks quickly and makes them laugh. Ronan wants a crowd too. He often feels this way near Leo.

He raises his voice at the next answer. The younger girl beside him stops reading and looks up.

Ronan lowers his voice again. He points to the title for the new visitor and lets Jun show the picture. Soon the two children talk about the basket. Ronan listens. He does not need to keep talking.

The activity ends. Miss Wu asks each group about the visitors' questions. Could they answer them? Jun mentions the gate. Ronan mentions the seeds. They could answer both from the book.

One group needs to change a line on its notice. Miss Wu helps them privately. Nobody announces a best group.

At lunch, Leo asks how it went.

“People read our book,” Ronan says.

“Mine too. One boy wanted the dog to have a hat.”

“It did not?”

“Only in his idea.”

Ronan remembers their enormous bell from last year. He laughs and tells Jun. Jun adds that the dog needs a ladder to reach the hat.

The three boys go outside with the cloth ball. The notices stay on the wall. Other children can stop and read them after lunch.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

notice＝介绍纸；clear＝清楚的；title＝标题。

## 理解问题

1. 小组的介绍纸怎样真正被使用？
2. Ronan怎样应对另一张更受欢迎的介绍？

## 读句子

**Ronan / lowers / his voice again.** Ronan／再次放低／声音。
